title: **Iran's FM Araghchi at Minab Exhibition: 'Human Rights Are Here,' Vows Never to Forget Incident**
text:
**Iran's FM Araghchi at Minab Exhibition: 'Human Rights Are Here,' Vows Never to Forget Incident**"

""
"Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, the Iranian Foreign Minister, made the remarks on the sidelines of his visit to the opening of the Minab School exhibition."

""If Westerners want to see, understand, and support human rights, they must come here. Human rights are here," Araghchi stated."

"He added, "The students of Minab School turned into an epic. We will neither forget nor forgive this incident.""

"The top diplomat also expressed hope, saying, "We are hopeful that we can transfer this exhibition to foreign countries.
